name: Freelance translator / localization linguist
summary: Join Welocalize's freelance talent community to receive translation, review and quality-check work in your language pairs, such as English–Canadian French.
whatYouDo: You register your language pairs, specialties and time zone and upload a CV; if matched, you receive projects such as translating, reviewing or quality-checking content. Senior French Canadian linguist roles also involve quality control and coordinating other freelancers.
appeal: Official talent page says Welocalize hires freelance translators and linguists worldwide
Canadian French appears as a named specialization in Welocalize postings
Builds a professional localization track record
watchOuts: Experienced roles found ask for a translation/applied-languages degree or equivalent and 3–4+ years of localization experience
French Canadian Linguist postings found were listed in the EU/UK, not Canada; check location rules
No pay rates published in sources found
Joining the talent pool does not guarantee projects
Negative-signal research (rates, payment reliability) could not be completed in this pass

credentials: Translation/applied languages degree or equivalent experience (senior linguist roles)

compensation.notes: No rates found in official or third-party sources during this pass.

reliability.notes: No evidence on project volume for new freelancers.

applicationSteps: Complete the form on Welocalize's talent site with language pairs, time zone and specialties
Wait to be matched; check individual postings (jobs.lever.co/welocalize) for role-specific requirements and location
fitsIf: You already translate or review between English and French (or another pair) professionally and want to add a large localization vendor as a client.
notFitIf: You are new to translation and have no localization experience or credentials.
